summary: Designed by MIT's Edgerton Center, this activity invites students to model the photosynthesis reaction with LEGO bricks by building the products from the reactants. Student start with carbon dioxide and water molecules and use them to create glucose and oxygen. Students can show how plants use glucose by modeling cellular respiration, and building starch and cellulose. In addition to a comprehensive activity, this resource also provides a full teacher guide and accompanying lesson.
objectives: - Students will develop an understanding of the photosynthesis reaction by modelling it with legos, building the products (glucose and oxygen) from the reactants (carbon dioxide and water). materials: Legos (1 set per group): 36 red bricks (2x4), 12 black bricks (2x4), 24 white bricks (1x2)
